job.title: Software Engineer (L3), Email
job.workplace: Not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA or WA
job.pay_full: $138,700 – $173,400 a year if based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington, D.C.; pay in other locations is discussed during hiring. May be eligible for equity and a corporate bonus

details.about: This is a hands-on engineering role within Twilio SendGrid, building and running massive-scale distributed email systems that regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday. The engineer helps modernize backend systems, optimize Go microservices and improve a dual-cloud setup on AWS and Microsoft Azure.
duties: Architect and ship reliable, low-latency features with product and technical leadership
Drive code reviews and high testing standards in the Go codebase
Manage cloud configuration on AWS and Azure with Terraform and improve metrics, alerts and tracing
Find technical debt, bottlenecks and single points of failure
Mentor junior engineers and lead technical sprint planning
needs: 4+ years of professional software engineering building and operating resilient backend services at scale
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools
Strong production experience in Go, Java or Python
Deploying and managing production workloads in the cloud, ideally AWS and Azure
Understanding of distributed datastores, caching and event streaming such as Kafka
Strong computer science fundamentals and data structures
nice: High-throughput applications on Docker and Kubernetes
Database migrations to managed services such as AWS Aurora
Network topology, proxy layers or mail transfer agent protocols
details.benefits: Estimated pay $138,700 – $173,400 a year if based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington, D.C.; pay in other locations is discussed during hiring. The role may be eligible for Twilio's equity plan and corporate bonus plan. Benefits generally include health care insurance, a 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off and paid parental leave.
notes: Remote, but not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA or WA
Occasional travel for in-person project or team meetings may be required
Applications are intended to be accepted until 12/31/2026, which may change with business needs
